state.title: naoqi_rest

content.uri: data:image/jpeg;base64,<camera image removed: physical NAO in a shared lab>

part.text:
I found the red ball, and the robot is now resting just in front of it, facing it.

- **Search:** I couldn't see the ball from the starting spot, so I walked about 1.5 m forward. I then moved left into the open part of the room, and from there I spotted the ball on the floor near a monitor stand.
- **Approach:** I walked toward it, turned to put it straight ahead, and stepped closer. The ball is now at the robot's feet, about 20–25 cm in front of it. That distance is my estimate from the camera image.
- **After rest:** When the robot crouched, its heading shifted about 9° to the right. The ball is still in view, a little left of center. In the last image, someone is measuring the distance with a tape measure.

No falls or problems along the way. Battery is at 79%.
